name: TestVanDammeAnim + BroBase base states
note: Every entry names the fields that steer ChangeFrame (TestVanDammeAnim.cs:4023-4210) to one Animate* method, the field the frames are stepped with, and the cells the base sprite sheet holds for it. Bare :NNNN line references are TestVanDammeAnim.cs; BroBase.cs is named explicitly. Expected cells were cross-checked against the sprite validator's base range table. The harness re-applies setup before every step, so animations that clear their own flag mid-sequence still run to the end of their column span. An entry with knownMismatch addresses fewer cells than its expect says for a reason the source explains, and the driver reports it separately from a real mismatch. An entry marked lethal pins the bro dead (actionState Dead, health 0), which a BroMaker hero takes for its death and runs its own OnDeath for, though the game itself takes no life and respawns nothing; the driver leaves it out unless includeLethal is set. Unless allowSideEffects, the harness skips the swept bro's UseSpecial, UsePockettedSpecial, PerformKnifeMeleeAttack, PerformPunchAttack, Land, TriggerFlexEvent, FireWeapon and ReleaseHeldObject, and the Map and MapController damage methods game-wide, for the duration of a sweep, so the states that walk those frames fire nothing at the level. A step's call list runs right after ChangeFrame, the way the game's Update runs RunGun after it; provide gives a state the ZipLine or ladder collider it needs.

states.name: idle_firing
states.note: The idle body of idle (AnimateActualIdleFrames :3494-3505) with the recoil walk on the gun, row 1 columns 3 to 0. Each step pins gunFrame one above the cell and gunCounter over RunGun's 0.0334 threshold, then calls RunGun (:9230-9242) after ChangeFrame, the order the game's Update runs them in; RunGun steps gunFrame down and draws SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0) (:9245-9263). gunCounter is put back to 0 after the call, so the bro's own Update does not step the gun again before the frame is read. ChangeFrame's own gun write is gated on gunFrame <= 0, so it leaves the recoil cell alone. fire is pinned as the firing animation has it; FireWeapon (:2389-2396) is suppressed unless allowSideEffects.

states.name: ladder_climb_down
states.note: ChangeFrame's ClimbingLadder arm (:4085-4119) -> AnimateClimbingLadder (:4240-4336), which needs IsNearbyLadder (:5907-5911), a 4-unit Physics.OverlapSphere on the Ladders layer at (X + localScale.x * 6, Y + 22). provide: ladder puts a ladder collider there for the state's length. Holding down, the down arm (:4304-4323) draws 8 + frame % 3 on row 6 with the gun deactivated; yI is pinned at 0 so the fast-slide foot poofs are not spawned. ladderClimbingTransitionFrames is pinned at 5, as for ladder_climb_up.

states.name: ladder_one_armed_hang
states.note: ChangeFrame's ClimbingLadder arm (:4085-4119) -> AnimateClimbingLadder (:4240-4336), which needs IsNearbyLadder (:5907-5911), a 4-unit Physics.OverlapSphere on the Ladders layer at (X + localScale.x * 6, Y + 22). provide: ladder puts a ladder collider there for the state's length. With no input the one-armed arm (:4263-4274) sets hangingOneArmed and draws 11 + frame % 3 on row 6, and the gun through SetGunSprite(0, 0) (:9245-9263), whose ClimbingLadder && hangingOneArmed branch adds gunSpriteHangingFrame (6): row 1 column 6. ladderClimbingTransitionFrames is pinned at 0 so the transition arm does not take the frame.

states.name: ladder_climb_legacy
states.note: ChangeFrame's ClimbingLadder arm (:4085-4119) -> AnimateClimbingLadder (:4240-4336), which needs IsNearbyLadder (:5907-5911), a 4-unit Physics.OverlapSphere on the Ladders layer at (X + localScale.x * 6, Y + 22). provide: ladder puts a ladder collider there for the state's length. Without useNewLadderClimbingFrames the moving arm (:4280-4303) draws frame % 4 on row 1 and the gun through SetGunSprite(0, 0): hangingOneArmed is false, so row 1 column 0.

states.name: zipline_moving
states.note: ChangeFrame's Jumping arm -> AnimateJumping, which dispatches on attachedToZipline != null (:3142-3145) to AnimateZipline (:3226-3252). provide: zipline gives the state an inactive, horizontal ZipLine 128 units wide centred over the bro, pinned as attachedToZipline on every step; inactive, it never runs its Start or Update. Holding right on a horizontal line, the moving arm (:3228-3233) draws 11 + frame % 12 on row 4 with the gun deactivated.

states.name: zipline_hanging
states.note: ChangeFrame's Jumping arm -> AnimateJumping, which dispatches on attachedToZipline != null (:3142-3145) to AnimateZipline (:3226-3252). provide: zipline gives the state an inactive, horizontal ZipLine 128 units wide centred over the bro, pinned as attachedToZipline on every step; inactive, it never runs its Start or Update. With no input the hanging arm (:3234-3251) draws 23 + Clamp(frame, 0, 5) on row 4 and writes no gun cell, so each step calls AttachToZipline (:3218-3223) with the provided line, as the game does on grabbing one: SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0) with Jumping and a zipline adds gunSpriteHangingFrame (6), row 1 column 6. It also zeroes frame after the cell is drawn, which the next step's pin undoes.

states.name: zipline_firing
states.note: ChangeFrame's Jumping arm -> AnimateJumping, which dispatches on attachedToZipline != null (:3142-3145) to AnimateZipline (:3226-3252). provide: zipline gives the state an inactive, horizontal ZipLine 128 units wide centred over the bro, pinned as attachedToZipline on every step; inactive, it never runs its Start or Update. Firing takes the hanging arm (:3234-3251, !fire fails the moving test), 23 on row 4 at frame 0; isGuts is false and slidingOnZipline is pinned false, so no particles are spawned. Each step pins gunFrame one above the cell and gunCounter over RunGun's 0.0334 threshold, then calls RunGun (:9230-9242) after ChangeFrame, the order the game's Update runs them in; RunGun steps gunFrame down and draws SetGunSprite(gunFrame, 0) (:9245-9263). gunCounter is put back to 0 after the call, so the bro's own Update does not step the gun again before the frame is read. ChangeFrame's own gun write is gated on gunFrame <= 0, so it leaves the recoil cell alone. fire is pinned as the firing animation has it; FireWeapon (:2389-2396) is suppressed unless allowSideEffects. SetGunSprite's zipline branch adds 6: row 1 columns 9 to 6.

states.name: wall_anticipation_stab
states.unsupported: keyed to a live world position
states.note: AnimateWallAnticipation :4455-4470 (row 3 columns 16-21 and 26-31) picks its column from Y + knifeClimbStabHeight - lastKnifeClimbStabY (:4454), a delta against the position where the knife was last planted. A static field value cannot express it, and the dispatch at ChangeFrame :4183-4186 also needs left/right plus canTouchLeftWalls/canTouchRightWalls, which are set by wall contact.

states.name: wall_climb_stab
states.unsupported: keyed to a live world position
states.note: AnimateWallClimb :4536-4547 (row 3 columns 16-21 and 26-31) is the frame >= 8 arm and picks its column from Y + knifeClimbStabHeight - lastKnifeClimbStabY (:4536), the same live delta.

states.name: frozen
states.unsupported: no cells on the bro sheet
